lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gills, with each column containing 3 to 5 primary nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular nodes, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and lower intensity (shadowing) on the ventral side of the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of significantly smaller high-luminance spots compared to the flank. An anthropogenic feature (snorkeler) is present in the upper background.
